title: Miniretain task spec v1
description: Single source of truth for the Go <-> Python boundary. Both sides load THIS file to validate and to fill defaults. Never hardcode a default in Go or Python separately.

job_id.description: Caller-visible job identifier, also the artifact directory name.

stage.description: Which Python worker stage to run.

workdir.description: Directory where spec.json / result.json / document.v1.json live.

source.description: Inline text to translate. A real build would pass a source_path here and the OCR adapter would read the PDF.

provider.description: OCR adapter name. Register real providers in python/ocr/adapter.py.
LLM client name. Register real clients in python/llm/scheduler.py.

batch_size.description: Items per LLM request. Missing key MUST use the same default on both sides.

model.description: Model identifier passed to the LLM client.

allow_partial.description: If false, any failed/missing/empty translation item fails the llm stage.

engine.description: Render engine: 'typst' for structured typesetting, 'pymupdf' for in-place bbox replacement.

font.description: Path to a CJK TTF/OTF font (for PyMuPDF) or font family name (for Typst).

output.description: Output filename inside the job workdir for backwards compatibility.

output_cn.description: Output filename for the pure Chinese translated PDF.

output_merged.description: Output filename for the bilingual merged comparison PDF.

layout_mode.description: Layout mode: 'preserve' for original-page overlay, 'flow' for A4 streaming, 'auto' picks preserve when PDF+bboxes exist.

bilingual_mode.description: Bilingual output mode: 'side_by_side' (left orig + right trans), 'interleaved', 'table', or 'auto'.

strict.description: If true, any unplaced/overflowed block fails the render stage instead of preserving source text.
